title: System Settings
subtitle: Customize interface language, typography style, and personalized preferences

languageSection.title: Interface Language
languageSection.description: Choose your primary display language across NipponMaster. The corresponding font automatically adjusts to Washi Editorial standards.
languageSection.syncNotice: This preference is automatically synced to the cloud across all your active devices.

vi.name: Tiếng Việt (Vietnamese)
vi.description: Standard editorial serif font with complete Vietnamese diacritic support, optimized for intensive reading.

en.name: English
en.description: Classic literary serif font designed for elegant clarity and effortless readability on digital screens.

typographySection.title: Typography Preview
typographySection.description: Each language uses a dedicated serif family paired seamlessly with Japanese Mincho for Kanji/Kana:
typographySection.latinSample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Mastery in Japanese language begins with deliberate, daily practice.
typographySection.japaneseLabel: Kanji & Japanese Characters (Noto Serif JP / Mincho)
typographySection.japaneseSample: 「千里の道も一歩から」— A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. 漢字・ひらがな・カタカナ。

furiganaSection.title: Furigana Display
furiganaSection.description: Toggle hiragana pronunciation ruby above Kanji characters in lessons and mock JLPT exams.
furiganaSection.hoverOnly: Show on hover only (Recommended for N3-N1)

themeSection.title: Theme & Color Palette
themeSection.description: Choose a color scheme suited for daytime or evening study environments.
